title: Remote Software Updates and Software Issues
summary: Feedback about software and remote updates centers on setup, notifications, and update execution, with clear complaints about connection problems and unavailable features but many fragments that only mention updates without enough sentiment context.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the software works well or that an OTA update was easy to complete.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe software connectivity and update problems, buggy behavior, and features that remain unusable pending a software fix.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention remote software updates, alerts, instructions, or attempted installs without enough detail to judge satisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so many mentions of software updates lack enough context to classify the customer attitude.
Several examples are brief administrative or procedural statements about update alerts, availability, or instructions rather than outcomes.
This topic includes both general software impressions and specific remote update process comments, so the subject is somewhat broad.
